items.title: Deepseek V4.1 Flash 1017 beats larger rivals in agentic tasks while once again massively cutting per-task costs

sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 新版发布： api 自带搜索能力
sources.title_zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 新版发布： api 自带搜索能力
sources.title_original: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 新版发布： api 自带搜索能力
sources.summary: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash 新版发布，这次把重点放在“更强也更省”：11 项基准全部提升，软件任务 max 档通过率 77%，单任务约 1.3 元，low 档不到 8 毛。作者梳理了三项实用变化：Harness、CodeBuddy 与 WorkBuddy 完成适配；少量提示即可从零搭游戏和 3D 项目；API 新增 Search 与 Fetch，可直接搜索并抓取网页。模型权重同步 MIT 开源，支持图文输入与 1M 上下文。想评估是否升级或接入 DeepSeek 的开发者，可以先看这篇。

items.title: Show HN: Sphinx——一个在发布前通过问答测试你AI代码的钩子

sources.title: Show HN: Sphinx——一个在发布前通过问答测试你AI代码的钩子
sources.title_zh: Show HN: Sphinx——一个在发布前通过问答测试你AI代码的钩子
sources.title_original: Show HN: Sphinx——一个在发布前通过问答测试你AI代码的钩子
sources.summary:
A Git hook for agent-assisted development. Before your agent’s code ships, Sphinx asks you a question about what it actually does.
“Outsource your thinking, not your understanding .”
— Sun Tzu
Sphinx is a Git hook for agent-assisted development. Before your agent’s code ships, it asks you a question about what that code actually does.
Built to run on minimal tokens, from your existing coding agent, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Sphinx
Your webhook handler now saves the event ID

primary_item.summary:
A Git hook for agent-assisted development. Before your agent’s code ships, Sphinx asks you a question about what it actually does.
“Outsource your thinking, not your understanding .”
— Sun Tzu
Sphinx is a Git hook for agent-assisted development. Before your agent’s code ships, it asks you a question about what that code actually does.
Built to run on minimal tokens, from your existing coding agent, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Sphinx
Your webhook handler now saves the event ID
